text:
anya (People Ops): Heads-up: new performance cycle timeline is live. Self-assessments open today and close Mon May 2 23:59 PT. Manager calibration blocks: May 3-7. Full guide + manager scoring sheet: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-cycle-2026.

mike (Eng Manager): Thanks! Quick clarifying q: are peer reviews required this cycle?

anya (People Ops): Peer feedback is optional but strongly encouraged for ICs with cross-team work. There's a short peer form in the guide (2 questions).

priya (IC): If someone is out on parental leave during calibration week, will their rating be blocked?

anya (People Ops): No. Use the extension request form for up to 3 business day extensions for leaves or illness: https://redwood.app/forms/perf-extension. Managers should add a note in the "Context for Calibration" field explaining the situation.

dave (SRE): Can Eng teams request an alternate calibration day? timezone pains last time.

mike (Eng Manager): Also asking for this. We had two ICs in APAC and one in EU, hard to get overlap.

rebecca (Recruiter): Suggestion from hiring ops: treat hires <30 days as "no formal rating" but capture ramp notes in the manager comments. Keeps things consistent.

anya (People Ops): Agreed. Policy: hires under 30 days don't get a rating; managers should add ramp plan + hiring feedback in the Onboarding & Ramp field.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessments open" will post in #people-ops and #eng in 1 hour.

priya (IC): Template request: is there a recommended length for self-assessments? I always stress about word count.

anya (People Ops): TL;DR: 3 bullets + 1 paragraph each (target 200-400 words total). Focus on measurable impact (metrics, links to PRs or dashboards). Self-Assessment Template in docs.

mike (Eng Manager): For managers: will the final rating be communicated automatically? Last time some folks missed emails.

anya (People Ops): Yes. After managers submit final ratings via the form, peopleops-bot will send an autogenerated email to each direct report with rating + manager comment within 72 business hours. Managers: double-check the email copy before submitting if you want to add extra context.

rebecca (Recruiter): One ops ask: can managers include recommended promotion readiness notes in a separate field? Hiring needs that signal.

anya (People Ops): Added a "Promotion Signals" optional field to the manager form. Keep notes crisp and evidence-based.

mike (Eng Manager): Can we get a dedicated Eng calibration slot? timezone-friendly please.

anya (People Ops): Srini is coordinating blocks and offered to reserve a 90-min Eng slot May 5 8:30-10 PT. If that conflicts, add availability to the doodle in the guide.

priya (IC): One more: if a manager disagrees with calibration outcome after the meeting, what's the appeal path?

anya (People Ops): Managers can request a recalibration within 3 business days via the recalibration form; people ops will triage and, if needed, schedule an escalated calibration with the director. Appeals from ICs follow a different HR process documented in the policy doc.

mike (Eng Manager): filed an extension for one report whoell sick. thanks.

anya (People Ops): Got it, Mike 917. I'll fast-track approval and confirm by EOD tomorrow. Please keep calibration notes concise for auditability.

peopleops-bot: Scheduled reminder: "Manager calibration week starts in 2 days" to post in #people-ops and channel-specific threads.
